blocks.title: Niveau 1 : Priorités simples
blocks.content: Relie chaque expression à sa valeur.
blocks.explanation:
On applique l'ordre des priorités : 1. Parenthèses, 2. Multiplications et divisions (de gauche à droite), 3. Additions et soustractions (de gauche à droite).

- $ rac{1}{2} +  rac{1}{3} 	imes  rac{3}{4} =  rac{1}{2} +  rac{1}{4} =  rac{2}{4} +  rac{1}{4} =  rac{3}{4}$.
- $( rac{1}{2} +  rac{1}{3}) 	imes  rac{3}{4} =  rac{5}{6} 	imes  rac{3}{4} =  rac{15}{24} =  rac{5}{8}$.
- $ rac{2}{5} 	imes  rac{5}{6} -  rac{1}{3} =  rac{10}{30} -  rac{1}{3} =  rac{1}{3} -  rac{1}{3} = 0$.
- $ rac{3}{4} -  rac{1}{2} 	imes  rac{2}{3} =  rac{3}{4} -  rac{1}{3} =  rac{9}{12} -  rac{4}{12} =  rac{5}{12}$.
- $ rac{1}{2} \div ( rac{2}{3} +  rac{1}{6}) =  rac{1}{2} \div  rac{5}{6} =  rac{1}{2} 	imes  rac{6}{5} =  rac{6}{10} =  rac{3}{5}$.

blocks.title: Niveau 2 : Barres de fraction et priorités
blocks.content: Relie chaque expression à sa valeur.
blocks.explanation:
La barre de fraction principale agit comme des parenthèses : on calcule d'abord le numérateur et le dénominateur séparément.

- $ rac{ rac{1}{2} +  rac{1}{4}}{ rac{3}{8}} =  rac{ rac{3}{4}}{ rac{3}{8}} =  rac{3}{4} 	imes  rac{8}{3} = 2$.
- $ rac{2}{3} 	imes  rac{3}{4} +  rac{1}{2} \div  rac{1}{4} =  rac{1}{2} + 2 =  rac{1}{2} +  rac{4}{2} =  rac{5}{2}$.
- $( rac{3}{5} -  rac{1}{10}) \div  rac{1}{2} =  rac{6}{10} -  rac{1}{10} =  rac{5}{10} =  rac{1}{2}$, puis $ rac{1}{2} \div  rac{1}{2} = 1$.
- $ rac{5}{6} -  rac{1}{3} 	imes  rac{3}{4} =  rac{5}{6} -  rac{1}{4} =  rac{10}{12} -  rac{3}{12} =  rac{7}{12}$.
- $ rac{ rac{1}{2} +  rac{1}{3}}{ rac{1}{4}} =  rac{ rac{5}{6}}{ rac{1}{4}} =  rac{5}{6} 	imes 4 =  rac{20}{6} =  rac{10}{3}$.

blocks.title: Niveau 3 : Expressions complexes
blocks.content: Relie chaque expression à sa valeur.
blocks.explanation:
On combine parenthèses explicites, barres de fraction (parenthèses implicites) et priorités classiques.

- $ rac{1}{2} 	imes ( rac{3}{4} -  rac{1}{2}) +  rac{1}{8} =  rac{1}{2} 	imes  rac{1}{4} +  rac{1}{8} =  rac{1}{8} +  rac{1}{8} =  rac{2}{8} =  rac{1}{4}$.
- $ rac{3}{4} \div ( rac{1}{2} +  rac{1}{4}) 	imes  rac{2}{3} =  rac{3}{4} \div  rac{3}{4} 	imes  rac{2}{3} = 1 	imes  rac{2}{3} =  rac{2}{3}$.
- $( rac{5}{6} -  rac{1}{3}) 	imes  rac{2}{5} +  rac{1}{10} =  rac{3}{6} 	imes  rac{2}{5} +  rac{1}{10} =  rac{1}{2} 	imes  rac{2}{5} +  rac{1}{10} =  rac{1}{5} +  rac{1}{10} =  rac{2}{10} +  rac{1}{10} =  rac{3}{10}$.
- $ rac{ rac{1}{2} +  rac{1}{3}}{ rac{1}{4} 	imes  rac{2}{3}} =  rac{ rac{5}{6}}{ rac{2}{12}} =  rac{ rac{5}{6}}{ rac{1}{6}} =  rac{5}{6} 	imes 6 = 5$.
- $ rac{2}{3} 	imes  rac{3}{5} -  rac{1}{5} \div  rac{1}{2} =  rac{2}{5} -  rac{2}{5} = 0$.
